sample_unit: AI-generated pain pattern markings (L4, L5, S1) at two time points, compared with two specialists' markings

links.outcome: Consistency of ChatGPT-4o pain pattern markings across repeated runs two weeks apart
links.effect: Initial and follow-up markings of L4, L5, and S1 radiculopathy patterns differed significantly from each other (P < 0.001 for all comparisons).
links.quote: ChatGPT's initial and follow-up markings of L4, L5, and S1 radiculopathy pain patterns were statistically significantly different from each other and from the specialists' markings (P < 0.001 for all comparisons).

links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT-4o lumbar radicular pain patterns versus specialist markings
links.effect: ChatGPT markings differed significantly from two specialists' markings for L4, L5, and S1 (P < 0.001); ChatGPT lacks capacity to accurately represent LRP patterns.
links.quote: ChatGPT currently lacks the capacity to accurately and consistently represent LRP patterns.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and consistency of ChatGPT-4o in generating and marking anatomical pain patterns for lumbar radiculopathies compared to human experts.
